topic: Spider-Man: Brand New Day becomes biggest Hollywood film in India
headline: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY SHATTERS BOX OFFICE RECORDS, BECOMES BIGGEST HOLLYWOOD FILM IN INDIA WITH MASSIVE OPENING
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has become the biggest Hollywood film in India, with the summer line-up in Indian cinemas leaning heavily on franchises and nostalgia. The film is part of a slate of big-ticket releases, including The Devil Wears Prada 2, Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu, and Toy Story 5. Tom Holland, the star of Spider-Man: Brand New Day, was recently injured on set, suffering a mild concussion while filming a stunt. The film's success in India is expected to lead the box office, with franchises and nostalgia traditionally performing well in the country.
